line: You know I be smoking that Tooky-Took (Smoking that Tooky-Took)
vault_lines: You know I be smoking that Tooky-Took (Smoking that Tooky-Took)
meaning:
When an enemy gang member is killed in Chicago, the death is referred to as getting smoked. In this line, Keef makes one of hundreds of references to Shondale “Tooka” Gregory, a Gangster Disciples member who on January 12, 2011 was gunned down at a bus stop. He was just 15 years old.
As a double entendre, whenever Keef rolls up a blunt, he refers to it as the Tooka pack out of disrespect (as if he’s smoking Tooka’s ashes) before taking a puff.

Chief Keef has said his smoking Tooka countless songs such as in one of his most popular songs “Earned It” he says

Take a Tooka blunt then I burned it
